row: Hi, I’m Marissa! I’m a veterinary technician with 10 years of experience in the field. I started this vlog to give you a real, behind-the-scenes look at the veterinary industry—both the challenges and the rewards. If you're curious about what it's like or considering a career in this field, you’re in the right place. Don’t forget to subscribe so you never miss a video! 🩷🐾
